newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips rally anew, Dow up 95 points.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips rally anew, Dow up 95 points.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks resumed their climb in mid-afternoon, pushing gains on the Dow industrials to almost the 100-point mark.
Large cap stocks continued to dominate the session. The Dow rose 95 points to 6645 and the S&P 500 index rose 7.7 points to 756.1. In contrast, the Russell 2000 was up less than a point to 365.
"This is more than most people expected today," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co. "The market just seems to say downturns aren't going to last very long."
The 30-year U.S. Treasury remained solidly higher, up 7/8 of a point to yield 6.77 percent.
